Kuthumi
ancient authority on dh. śāstra. [Page192-a.
--Kuthumismṛti. Q. by Raghunandana in Malamāsatattva an. Śrāddhatattva (see Poona Ori. XXI. p. 64) an. Vācaspati in Kṛtyamahārṇava, (RASB. III. 1958) by Aparārka, Jīmūtavāhana an. Hemādri (see Kane, HDS. I. p. 686); by Nīlāmbarācārya in Kālakaumudī (see p. 83, J. of G. Jhā. Res. Inst. XIV. i-iv. 1956-57); in Śuddhikaumudī of Govindānanda (p. 294. Bib. Ind. edn. 1905) an. by Bṛhaspati Rāyamukuṭamaṇi in Smṛtiratnahāra (see RASB. III. 2138). See also below Kauthumi.

Kuthumi
Q. in Siddhasenagaṇi's C. on Umāsvāti's Tattvārthādhigamasūtra, VIII. 1. (p. 123, Seth Devchand Lalbhai Jainapustakoddhar Fund Series, 76).
